text: From the first I have sought to impress the students with the idea that Tuskegee is not my institution, or that of the officers, but that it is their institution, and that they have as much interest in it as any of the trustees or instructors. I have further sought to have them feel that I am at the institution as their friend and adviser, and not as their overseer.
author: Booker T. Washington
locator: Chapter XI, Making Their Beds Before They Could Lie On Them
